articles.title: Hegseth uses Venezuela visit to boast of Maduro’s capture by US military
articles.summary:
Defense secretary asserts US dominance on trip that would have seemed ‘impossible, almost unbelievable’ a year ago

Pete Hegseth has used his first visit to Venezuela since US special forces abducted its former president, Nicolás Maduro, to boast of the dictator’s capture during what he called “the single most sophisticated military operation in the history of Latin America”.

Maduro was controversially seized by Delta Force operatives in the early hours of 3 January, setting in motion an improbable rapprochement between Washington and Venezuela’s anti-imperialist “Chavista” regime, which has ruled since 1999.

articles.title: The Quechua rapper and an artistic movement reclaiming language of the Incas
articles.summary:
Renata Flores has gained global recognition for her music in Indigenous language whose speakers have faced social stigma

With her long black hair braided into beaded plaits, a delicate silver nose ring, and intricately patterned Andean textile draped around her chest above baggy, low-riding jeans, Renata Flores is a visual reflection of her music: a fusion of traditional and transgressive, old and new, rural and urban.

Nicknamed the “queen of Quechua rap”, Flores, 25, has earned global recognition for mixing Peru’s main Indigenous language and Andean instruments with the urban beats of trap, rap, hip-hop and reggaeton.

Indigenous Awá people of Amazon make contact with villagers and accept food to take back to territory

About 20 Indigenous people emerged from isolation in Brazil’s Amazon rainforest, several organizations reported on Tuesday, raising the alarm about increased invasions into the tribe’s territory.

According to the NGO Survival International, members of the Awá people, who live in voluntary isolation, arrived on Monday in a village and made contact with a government team in a “historic encounter”.

articles.title: US, Mexico and Bolivia lose measles-free status as deaths mount
articles.summary: The US has lost its measles-free status, international health officials said Tuesday, as the highly contagious virus has spread at the fastest rate in more than 30 years, while Mexico and Bolivia also lost their measles-elimination status. Vaccination rates have been falling against a number of diseases, in the US and globally, and measles has been spreading throughout the Americas since 2024.

The first known killing of a journalist ⁠in Costa Rica in ⁠25 years, ​Rodriguez’s death comes as the country grapples with a surge in drug violence driven by international trafficking groups, despite long ⁠being regarded as one of Central America’s most peaceful and stable democracies.

archive.security_status_cs: Jižní čelí vážným politickým a bezpečnostním otřesům, dominovaným pádem paraguayského prezidenta Santiaga Peni v důsledku bankovního skandálu a masovými protesty v Chile kvůli cenám pohonných hmot. archive.security_status_en: South America is grappling with acute political and security shocks, highlighted by the impeachment and arrest of Paraguayan President Santiago Peña amid a banking scandal and mass fuel-price protests in Chile. Organized crime and cartel violence continue to spread across the region, triggering aggressive security crackdowns from Bolivia to Ecuador. Meanwhile, broader macroeconomic conditions remain weighed down by persistent global inflation concerns and US monetary policy pressures.

archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, markets will watch for the stabilization of Paraguay's political landscape following the government collapse and monitor the economic fallout of transport protests in Chile.

archive.security_status_cs: Region čelí vážným institucionálním krizím včetně zatčení představitelů paraguayského bankovního sektoru a politických turbulencí. V Chile paralyzují dopravu protesty proti cenám paliv, zatímco organizovaný zločin stupňuje tlak na místní představitele.

archive.security_status_cs: Jižní čelí rostoucímu napětí kvůli dopravním blokádám v Chile, vysoké inflaci a politickým otřesům včetně rozsáhlého korupčního skandálu a zatčení činitelů v Paraguayi. Bezpečnostní situace se zhoršuje v důsledku šíření organizovaného zločinu a regionálních zásahů, přičemž mezinárodní trhy reagují na globální komoditní výkyvy a politickou nestabilitu.
archive.security_status_en: South America is facing rising tensions driven by transport blockades in Chile, high inflation, and political shocks including a major corruption scandal and the arrest of officials in Paraguay. Security conditions are deteriorating due to expanding organized crime and regional enforcement operations, while international markets react to global commodity swings and political instability.

archive.security_status_cs: Bezpečnostní situace v regionu zůstává napjatá kvůli eskalujícím aktivitám organizovaného zločinu (zejména v Kolumbii, Chile a Paraguayi, kde pád banky Ueno odhalil hluboké vazby na korupci) a přetrvávajícím politickým třenicím v Argentině. Argentinská inflace klesla na 2,2 %, nicméně napětí mezi prezidentem Mileim a papežem Lvem XIV. a bizarní útěk italského teroristy z domácí věznice podtrhují domácí nestabilitu. archive.security_status_en: The security situation in the region remains tense due to escalating organized crime activities (notably in Colombia, Chile, and Paraguay, where the collapse of Ueno Bank exposed deep corruption ties) and persistent political friction in Argentina. Argentine inflation eased to 2.2%, yet tensions between President Milei and Pope Leo XIV and the dramatic prison escape of an Italian terrorist highlight domestic instability. Meanwhile, commodity markets saw coffee prices hit record levels following the aversion of US-Colombia tariff disputes.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat zvýšenou politickou nervozitu v Argentině a Paraguayi kvůli skandálům, zatímco komoditní trhy se soustředí na volatilitu ropy a rekordní ceny kávy.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, elevated political nervousness is expected in Argentina and Paraguay due to ongoing scandals, while commodity markets will focus on oil volatility and record coffee prices.

archive.security_status_cs: Jižní čelí rostoucímu napětí spojenému s organizovaným zločinem v Chile, Kolumbii a Paraguayi, kde bankovní skandály a útoky odhalují slabá místa finančního sektoru. Simultaneously, key diplomatic and political maneuvers are underway, including Venezuelan peace talks and the Pope's visit to Peru, which help temper social friction. Commodity markets remain sensitive to fluctuating crude prices and record-high Arabica coffee rates amid tariff spats.

archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, intensified anti-crime crackdowns in the Andean region and persistent pricing pressure on key commodities like coffee and oil are expected.
